title: Oracle volatility
description: How much the oracle price has been moving over the last minute, five minutes and hour. Higher volatility means a round is likelier to end far from its strike.

volatility_bps_1m.label: Volatility 1m
volatility_bps_1m.description: The spread of returns over the last minute, in basis points. Bigger means the price is swinging more.

volatility_bps_5m.label: Volatility 5m
volatility_bps_5m.description: The spread of returns over the last five minutes, in basis points. The window most fifteen-minute rounds care about.

volatility_bps_1h.label: Volatility 1h
volatility_bps_1h.description: The spread of returns over the last hour, in basis points. The slow baseline the shorter reads are compared with.

regime.label: Volatility regime
regime.description: Rising when the short window is hotter than the long one, falling when calmer, steady in between. Rising volatility widens the range of likely closes.
